definitions.gloss: stone statue; stone figure; stone sculpture
definitions.explanation: A statue or figure carved from stone. Includes religious statues, monuments, and decorative sculptures.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}に{大|おお}きな{石像|せきぞう}がある。
examples.english: There is a large stone statue in the park.

examples.japanese: {神社|じんじゃ}の{入|い}り{口|ぐち}に{狛犬|こまいぬ}の{石像|せきぞう}が{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Stone statues of guardian dogs stand at the entrance to the shrine.

examples.japanese: {何百年|なんびゃくねん}も{前|まえ}に{造|つく}られた{石像|せきぞう}が、{風化|ふうか}しながらも{今|いま}なお{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: Stone statues made hundreds of years ago still remain, though weathered.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in descriptions of temples, shrines, parks, and historical sites. Japan has many {石像|せきぞう}, including {地蔵|じぞう} (Jizo statues) found along roadsides and in cemeteries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石像|せきぞう}が{立|た}つ (a stone statue stands)
- {石像|せきぞう}を{彫|ほ}る (to carve a stone statue)
- {石像|せきぞう}のように{動|うご}かない (to stand motionless like a stone statue)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {銅像|どうぞう}: bronze statue — made of bronze rather than stone
- {仏像|ぶつぞう}: Buddhist statue — specifically a Buddha figure, of any material
